segments.name: Agriculture
segments.description: Sells and services agricultural equipment, parts and related services to farmers in U.S. farming regions.
segments.evidence: We operate our business in four reportable segments, Agriculture, Construction, Europe and Australia, within which we engage in four principal business activities:

segments.name: Construction
segments.description: Sells and services construction equipment, parts and related services for commercial, residential and infrastructure construction customers.
segments.evidence: Our Construction stores are located in Colorado, Iowa, Minnesota, Nebraska, North Dakota, South Dakota, and Wisconsin.

segments.name: Europe
segments.description: Operates full service agricultural and construction equipment stores in Bulgaria, Germany, Romania and Ukraine.
segments.evidence: Internationally, our European stores are located in Bulgaria, Germany, Romania, and Ukraine, and our Australian stores are located in New South Wales, South Australia, and Victoria in Southeastern Australia.

segments.name: Australia
segments.description: Operates full service agricultural and construction equipment stores in southeastern Australia.
segments.evidence: Our Australian stores are located in New South Wales, South Australia, and Victoria in Southeastern Australia.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for new and used equipment, parts, repair and maintenance services, equipment rental and ancillary products such as GPS subscriptions and finance and insurance products.
revenueModel.evidence: Within each of our segments, we have four principal sources of revenue: new and used equipment sales, parts sales, equipment repair and maintenance services, and equipment rental and other business activities.
